verdict.rationale: Unity documents a Package Manager that delivers enhancements as packages, and probes show a live UPM registry (packages.unity.com) serving packages. Community posts confirm a Unity store that distributes third-party plugins such as VLC-Unity. However, nothing documents the store's size, ready-made 3D models, or a catalog of tools and plugins. missing for 10: first-party Asset Store documentation, evidence of ecosystem scale, ready-made models/art assets, third-party tool/plugin catalog breadth, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins
